canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Yasis Wyran: 21-year-old man, 159 cm (short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: heart-shaped face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; aquiline nose, softly full mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: one asymmetric ear cuff; one mismatched earring. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
